_README: READ THIS BEFORE CHANGING ANY NUMBER IN THIS FILE.
These are HAND-AUTHORED REFERENCE PROFILES. They were NOT measured from
video of the named athletes, and no part of this repository contains such
measurements. They are plausible target joint angles for a well-executed
overhead badminton shot, written by hand, carried forward from the
original _TEMPLATES dict in scripts/analyze_badminton_video_rule_based.py.
The athlete names are labels for a STYLE OF TARGET FORM, not a claim that
this is what that player's body actually does. Any UI copy derived from
this file must say 'reference profile' and must never say the user is a
percentage 'as good as' a named athlete.
If someone later derives real per-athlete values from broadcast or lab
footage, set provenance to 'video_derived', fill in source_note, and the
wording the API emits will change automatically - see comparison.py.
MEASUREMENT CONVENTIONS (these MUST match detector._frame_angles):
elbow_angle             interior angle shoulder-elbow-wrist. 180 = fully extended.
shoulder_elevation      angle of the upper arm above horizontal, measured at
the shoulder. 0 = arm horizontal, 90 = arm straight up.
knee_angle              interior angle hip-knee-ankle. 180 = fully extended.
hip_shoulder_separation absolute difference in image-plane bearing between the
shoulder line and the hip line. 0 = square, higher =
more trunk rotation. 2D proxy, no depth used.
torso_inclination       deviation of the hip->shoulder axis from vertical.
0 = perfectly upright.
The v1 file used different conventions for the last three features while
the template numbers assumed yet another convention, which is why every
real analysis scored 0.0. See docs/TECHNIQUE_METHODOLOGY.md.
